text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Four, five, six!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year's, Jordan! Wanna grab
a burger?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, can't today! Thirteen, fourteen...
fifteen!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Agh... Messed up again. Isn't fifteen
seconds
exact a bit too specific?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Uhh... So, like... what's going on?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My trainer gave me a challenge. If I can
count
fifteen seconds exactly...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I get to go out for an expensive meal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan is now in her classic year.
Up until
now, she's been up against
beginners, but this
year will be a
different story.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
More of her opponents will be trained to
their
peak abilities, with a better grasp
of how to race
using their unique talents.
They'll be ready for
whatever comes
their way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For that purpose, I've put together a
two-stage
training program to improve
her time awareness.
choice_data_list: （彼女だけの武器を作らないと……）
choice_data_list_en: (We need to forge a weapon unique to her...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For stage one, we're using this
stopwatch
training, which is set up like a
game so she can
meld it seamlessly into
her everyday routine. And
as for the
second stage...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Slide!

text_block_list.name: Helios and Palmer
text_block_list.text: Suh, faaam! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, so, about this morning's
challenge? All
three of us are gonna do
it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You've gotta treat us all to the
expensive buffet,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! We've gotta run?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the second stage, we're aiming to
improve the
accuracy of her internal
clock.
choice_data_list: 200mを15秒でな
200mを15秒でね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In an actual race, a runner needs an
accurate
sense of time to judge whether
the race is
progressing at a fast or slow
pace.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My aim is to calibrate her internal clock
so that
she can read the race and kick
off her sprint at
the optimal time.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But that's not what you said! All you said
I had to
do was count to fifteen.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Umm... I guess so?
choice_data_list: 頭の中で15秒数えるのは同じだろ？
頭の中で15秒数えるのは同じだよ？
choice_data_list_en: Counting fifteen seconds in your head is the same either way, right?
Counting fifteen seconds in your head is the same either way, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Okay, fifteen seconds, then! Grab your

stopwatch—let's do it! Ready...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Three, four...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan counts aloud as she runs.
She
finishes one furlong, or two hundred
meters, in...

text_block_list.name: Helios and Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Argh... Too quick!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her stopwatch training may have been
somewhat
effective. I sense that she's
grown.
choice_data_list: でも惜しかった！

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No cap, that looks mad fun! ☆ Let me
have a
shot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Me too! Just give me one chance!
choice_data_list: えっ！？

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
All right, three-person rematch! Let's
gooo!

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three of them are already off down
the track.
And the result...

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
Nooo...
Damn!

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: なんでレースになってるんだ！？
なんでレースになってるの！？
choice_data_list_en: How did this turn into a race!?
Why did this turn into a race!?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They've completely forgotten about
trying to
finish in exactly fifteen
seconds.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Because racing gets us, like, jazzed
or
whatever. It's only natural, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Cool, thanks!
choice_data_list: 今度はその点を考慮するよ……
choice_data_list_en: I'll take that into account next time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All things considered, she took on the
challenge I
set for her in her own way,
so...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah! For real?!
choice_data_list: 食べ放題に行こうか
choice_data_list_en: Shall we go to an all-you-can-eat buffet?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
That's cool, no problem! ♪ Let's bounce,
ASAP! ♪
choice_data_list: 超高級ほどではないけど

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So, where are we going exactly?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, sounds like you really get it.
choice_data_list: スタミナたっぷりにんじんバーグ食べ放題！
まったり寿司食べ放題
新年を味わう！おせち食べ放題
choice_data_list_en: Savor the New Year! All-You-Can-Eat Osechi

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I think my heart just skipped a beat. Or something did, anyway. Maybe my stomach?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Low-key, you're just hungry. ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Bingo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So let's go already.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Sushi?! OMG! Yass!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Are you for real, Trainer? You're
a genius!

text_block_list.name: Helios and Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sushiii! ♪
Sushi, sushiii! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Now let's go already.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You mean, like... traditional traditional? Are we going to your granny's house or something?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: We can go to my granny's place! You guys are fam, always welcome!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: For real?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Look at Trainer sweat! You gotta
lighten
up!
choice_data_list: 流石に申し訳ないので、お店にしよう
choice_data_list_en: I'd really feel bad otherwise, so let's just go to a restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Now let's go already.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Uhh... No, it's nothing. You go on ahead.
I'll meet
you at the school gate in a sec.
choice_data_list: どうした？
どうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Urgh... It's coming off again...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Jordan? What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Um... my press-on is coming off. I'm
sticking it
back on again.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Again? I wonder if maybe your actual
nails are
getting weak.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... Nah, they're fine! It's fine! This
tape just
isn't strong enough.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If you come across any decent tape,
lemme know!
Thank youuuu! ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll ask my makeup artist. You'll want
something
that doesn't damage your
skin.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hehe... ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Thanks, City!
